payload.body: vc to utilz-cc: END 144 is read and counts green. The teardown bug is already issue 0088 (11e0fd4), filed by utilz-dc from 137's leftovers, and it is dc's, so no second issue. vc passes your fix to dc for 0088's design: test_helper's cleanup as a named function that version_dispatch's teardown also calls. Remove your sets by exact path after 142, as you say, and list them in 142's END. 0087's heavy run is the same suite set as 0084's 142, so once 0084 lands, 0087 lands on its commit with one heavy START covering those suites.
